articles.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
articles.description: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.

articles.title: Football : Emmanuel Macron condamne fermement les violences contre des supporteurs bulgares à Marseille, Sofia réclame une enquête
articles.description: Les affrontements survenus avant la rencontre de Ligue Europa entre l’Olympique de Marseille et le Levski Sofia, jeudi, au Stade-Vélodrome, ont fait une douzaine de blessés parmi les supporteurs bulgares, selon la préfecture de police des Bouches-du-Rhône.

articles.title: En Suisse, un scrutin qui sent la poudre
articles.description: Les citoyens sont appelés aux urnes dimanche 29 novembre pour dire s’ils souhaitent interdire aux particuliers d’acheter et d’utiliser des feux d’artifice, accusés notamment de provoquer régulièrement des incendies et des accidents.

articles.title: Ligue Europa : Marseille reprend espoir, Lyon freiné et le Stade Rennais s'incline
articles.description: La 5e journée de la phase de poules de la Ligue Europa a été marquée, jeudi, par la victoire de Marseille face au Levski Sofia (1-0), le nul de l'Olympique Lyonnais contre Lillestroem (0-0), ainsi que la mauvaise passe de Rennes, battu par Nimègue (3-1).

articles.title: I spend £200 a month on fancy meals by myself - would you dine solo?
articles.description: Solo-dining is being embraced as a self-care trend and it's reshaping the restaurant industry.

articles.description: Almost one million customers in the US had no power on Thursday evening as storms descended on both US coasts, bringing wind gusts, heavy rain and flooding.

articles.title: Met Police ruined my life, says Kenyan man wrongly sentenced over attack on UK couple
articles.description: Evidence from a British police officer helped convict Ali Kololo over a 2011 attack in the Kenyan resort of Lamu.

articles.title: Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind
articles.description: The ousted prime minister's December homecoming plan deepens Dhaka-Delhi tensions and risks fresh unrest.

articles.title: Thanksgiving : ce que Friends ne raconte pas
articles.description: Aux États-Unis, ce jeudi, c’est Thanksgiving. Des millions d’Américains prennent la route pour se retrouver autour d'une énorme dinde, c'est la tradition. Mais derrière ce repas copieux et les récits populaires qui en découlent, notamment dans les films et séries, se cache une réalité historique tragique.

articles.title: Théâtre: dans la pièce «Nocturne (Parade)», les marionnettes de Phia Ménard dansent avec le vent
articles.description: Le vent est le chef d'orchestre de la dernière pièce de Phia Ménard. Ses objets marionnettes faits de plastique fin s'envolent dans une chorégraphie aléatoire et nous emmènent aux tréfonds de la nuit, là où se trouvent les forces du mal. Face aux êtres malfaisants se dressent des vies fragiles qui s'élèvent et résistent avec grâce. Phia Ménard vient du jonglage. Elle signe, avec Nocturne (Parade), une pièce sur l'état actuel du monde. La pièce donnée au Théâtre 71 à Malakoff est en tournée en France et en Belgique jusqu'au printemps prochain.

articles.title: Le marché mondial va t-il bientôt devoir se priver de riz indien?
articles.description: La production de riz du premier exportateur mondial, l'Inde, devrait baisser pour la première fois depuis dix ans. Certaines variétés ont été très affectées par le manque de précipitations, en raison du phénomène climatique El Niño. Les prix s'en ressentent : ils sont en hausse.

articles.title: Irak: la loi jafarite légalise les mariages précoces et forcés
articles.description: En Irak, l'amendement de la loi qui régit les normes familiales est entré en vigueur depuis un an. Il permet aux familles chiites d'appliquer des règles issues du droit musulman chiite jafarite. Le code jafarite, adopté en août 2025, définit l'âge auquel une fille est considérée comme pubère, donc en âge d'être mariée : 9 ans. Cela complique la garde des enfants au détriment des mères et au profit des pères. Un an après sa mise en application, les conséquences de ce code inquiète les femmes irakiennes.

articles.title: Why is there a shortage of 'wizard' elevator mechanics?
articles.description: The pay is good and there's lots of work, so what's behind the shortage of elevator mechanics?

articles.title: Au Gabon, la ville de Mayumba mise sur le fer pour sortir de l'ornière
articles.description: Alors que trois gisements de fer doivent entrer en production au Gabon dès 2027, selon les prévisions de l'État, Mayumba, dans le sud du pays, nourrit de grands espoirs. Cette petite ville côtière de 6 000 habitants mise sur les projets miniers et les infrastructures annoncées pour sortir de la pauvreté.

articles.title: Royaume-Uni: la petite ville de Battle surfe sur la Bayeux-mania
articles.description: À Londres, l'engouement autour de la tapisserie de Bayeux ne faiblit pas. Depuis la mi-septembre, elle s'expose au British Museum. La tapisserie de Bayeux, 70 mètres de long et vieille de presque un millénaire, représente un moment fondateur de l'histoire anglaise : la bataille d'Hastings, qui marque la conquête de l'Angleterre par Guillaume et l'unification des petits royaumes en une seule puissance. Dans l'est de l'Angleterre, le site de la bataille d'Hastings, bien-nommée Battle, était jusqu'ici assez peu connu en dehors des initiés, mais il surfe désormais sur cette vague de popularité, en proposant par exemple des ateliers broderie pendant les vacances.

articles.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Kiev n’a « aucune intention d’étendre la guerre à la Libye », assure le chef de la diplomatie ukrainienne
articles.description: Andrii Sybiha dit avoir expliqué à son homologue libyen, Taher Al-Baour, « qu’aucune des actions de l’Ukraine n’a jamais été dirigée contre la Libye ou le peuple libyen, uniquement contre des objets militaires russes servant directement à la guerre de la Russie contre l’Ukraine ». Kiev a revendiqué lundi des frappes contre deux navires russes, près de Benghazi.

articles.title: UK to pay 'participation' fee to deliver EU deals
articles.description: Details of the contribution towards EU running costs have been revealed in new legal documents.

articles.title: Les évolutions de la littérature jeunesse, reflets de la société
articles.description: C'est le rendez-vous annuel des enfants, des ados, et de celles et ceux qui leur racontent des histoires et leur font découvrir le monde : le Salon du livre et de la presse jeunesse à Montreuil. La littérature jeunesse bouge avec son temps. Elle a beaucoup évolué, en laissant une plus grande place aux sujets de société, tels que les questions d'identité, de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, de modèle familial ou encore de l'inceste.

articles.title: Asia made a big AI bet on Nvidia. What happens now?
articles.description: Asian stocks have been on a rollercoaster ride after Jensen Huang's shock return as Nvidia CEO.

articles.title: My dad's watch stopped the moment he died - I found it in the ashes of Hong Kong tower fire
articles.description: The city marks a year since a huge blaze tore through seven apartment blocks, killing 168 people.

articles.title: Massacre de Shakahola au Kenya: le gourou de la secte, son épouse et son bras droit reconnus coupables de terrorisme
articles.description: Nouveau chapitre judiciaire dans l'affaire du massacre de Shakahola, au Kenya. Le pasteur autoproclamé Paul Mackenzie a été reconnu coupable de radicalisation et de terrorisme, jeudi 26 novembre, par le tribunal de Shanzu, à Mombasa. C'est la troisième condamnation du pasteur dans cette affaire. Début novembre, il avait déjà été condamné à 200 ans de prison pour meurtre. Au moins 430 personnes sont mortes en suivant les préceptes de sa secte, qui encourageait ses disciples à mourir de faim pour « rencontrer Jésus ».

articles.title: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC
articles.description: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is "strange" Trump has described Vladimir Putin as a friend.

articles.title: Élections en Espagne : les socialistes de Pedro Sanchez orchestrent-ils une "fraude massive" ?
articles.description: À quelques jours d’élections législatives anticipées cruciales pour le Premier ministre socialiste Pedro Sánchez, les accusations de fraude électorale se multiplient en Espagne. Détournement d'identité numérique, vote par correspondance truqué ou encore migrants rajoutés dans des listes : les intox s'empilent pour tenter de jeter le discrédit sur le scrutin.

articles.description:

articles.description: Dans l'édition du jour, Cyril Ramaphosa écarte la procédure de destitution qui aurait pu mettre un terme à sa présidence. Le chef de l'État sud-africain a été accusé d'avoir caché à la police et au fisc un cambriolage en 2020 dans sa ferme luxueuse de Phala Phala.

articles.title: Depuis Bruxelles, Emmanuel Macron reproche à Marine Le Pen de faire preuve d’une « drôle d’arrogance » en pensant « qu’elle serait déjà en charge du destin de la France »
articles.description: La candidate du Rassemblement national a accusé le président de la République de s’adonner à de « basses manœuvres politiciennes » visant à conclure, d’ici à la fin de l’année, un accord sur le budget européen, qu’il lui serait difficile de remettre en cause si elle remportait l’élection présidentielle.

articles.title: Football: des violences en Géorgie contre des supporters turcs tournent à l'incident diplomatique
articles.description: La Fédération turque de football a dénoncé, jeudi 26 novembre, des actes « inqualifiables » visant des supporters du club de Besiktas. articles.title: Netflix’s coziest show has made a very quiet return
articles.description:
The bigger Netflix gets, the easier it is to miss stuff. This is true of all digital platforms, of course, but it's especially true of Netflix of late, as the streaming service's lineup now also includes a growing library of reality shows, live-programming, and even games. It makes it easy for some of the best shows to zoom right past you, unnoticed - which almost happened to me with Midnight Diner.
If you haven't seen it, Midnight Diner is probably the most comforting thing available on Netflix. The show follows the patrons of a cozy little restaurant tucked away in the backstreets of Shinjuku, which is only open during the unusual hours o …
Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.title: Guinée-Bissau: report de deux ans de la présidentielle initialement prévue le 6 décembre
articles.description: En Guinée-Bissau, le président de transition fixe une nouvelle date pour les élections présidentielle et législatives. Un an après le coup d'État qui a interrompu le processus électoral à la veille de la publication des résultats, le général Horta N'Tam a signé, jeudi 26 novembre 2026, un décret fixant la tenue des scrutins au 26 novembre 2028, soit trois ans après sa prise de pouvoir. Ils étaient initialement prévus pour le 6 décembre prochain, mais le mois dernier, la commission électorale et le Premier ministre de transition avaient jugé que cette date n'était techniquement pas tenable.

articles.title: L'Algérie accuse la France de "maltraitances" sur un agent consulaire détenu depuis 2025
articles.description: Le ministre algérien des Affaires étrangères, Ahmed Attaf, a accusé jeudi la France d'avoir maltraité un agent consulaire détenu depuis 2025 dans l'Hexagone et mis en examen dans le cadre de l'enlèvement de l'influenceur algérien Amir Boukhors. Le gouvernement l'assure : les grenades assourdissantes ou de désencerclement ne sont pas des armes létales, mais des armes intermédiaires. Pourtant, des personnes ont été gravement blessées. articles.description: Les Espagnols se rendent aux urnes dimanche pour des élections législatives anticipées. Porté par une dynamique favorable, Vox, le parti d’extrême droite a le vent en poupe et pourrait jouer les faiseurs de roi en rejoignant une coalition de droite avec le parti conservateur. articles.description:
En Haïti, le gouvernement fait appel au Salvador pour lutter contre les gangs. articles.description: Lundi, le président ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky a revendiqué l'attaque de deux navires russes le long des côtes libyennes avec des drones navals. Ces modèles de drones ont été utilisés à plusieurs reprises ces derniers mois par l'armée ukrainienne.

articles.title: The Garmin Forerunner 265S is down to $300, its best price of the year
articles.description:
The Forerunner 265S is great for runners with small wrists. | Photo by Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge	

The Forerunner 265S may not be the newest or flashiest Garmin, but it’s one that I’ve always loved most in testing. For runners with smaller wrists, it fits nicely. The battery life is pretty good thanks in part to its OLED touchscreen. When I reviewed it a few years ago, I called it the Goldilocks of fitness watches at the time, and the only thing that bugged me was its price. But now that it’s down to $299.99 (a $150 discount off its MSRP) at Amazon and Best Buy for Black Friday, I can easily recommend it.
Garmin Forerunner 265S (42mm)
Garmin’s Forerunner 265S is identical to the standard 265, only it features a slightly better battery life and a smaller 42mm build for those with more petite wrists.

Where to Buy:

 $449.99 $299.99 at Amazon
 $449.99 $299.99 at Best Buy

The neat thing about Garmins in general is that you really don’t need the latest models to get the most out of the company’s platform. Its watches tend to get firmware updates for several years after launch, which is how long the average Garmin user tends to hold on to theirs. This particular watch is best suited for folks who want something a bit slimmer and smaller, enjoy a pop of color, and want a little extra fitness tracking prowess — but don’t need the whole kit and caboodle that sends the price up by hundreds.
There are a few other Garmin models I like that are also on sale during Black Friday. I wish that I had 10 arms to fully vet every single last one, but alas. That said, here are some others that I have tested and recommend:
The Garmin Fenix 8 is $749 at Amazon, Best Buy, and REI, which is a 25 percent discount off its original price. Its higher price comes down to having more features than the Forerunner 265S, so it’s really best for someone who does multiple outdoor sports and could make use of its handy LED flashlight.
Garmin’s Venu 4 is $449 at Amazon, Best Buy, and REI, an 18 percent discount. This is a great option if you’re looking for more of a smartwatch that does fitness than a fitness-y watch that looks like a smartwatch. It’s a fine line, but if you know, you know.
Finally, Garmin’s Forerunner 970 is $100 off, costing $649 at Amazon, Best Buy, and REI. This is what I’d recommend to marathoners who need something a bit more robust but not as heavy-duty as the flagship Fenix line. I’ve used it to train for a few races and it’s a solid upper-midrange (for Garmin!) option.

articles.description: Mercredi 25 novembre, des juges ont mis en doute certaines des poursuites lancées contre le Premier ministre sortant Benyamin Nétanyahou. articles.description: Le 30 octobre, sur la base d’Adazi, en Lettonie, a été organisée une simulation grandeur nature de défense du territoire de l’Alliance atlantique, intégralement coordonnée par l’intelligence artificielle du système américain Palantir. L’exercice a eu lieu dans le contexte d’une lutte impitoyable entre industriels de l’armement, licornes de l’intelligence artificielle et états-majors pour faire face à des changements majeurs sur le plan de la souveraineté et de la conduite de la guerre en Europe.

articles.title: The MacBook Neo is receiving a rare $100 discount for Black Friday
articles.description:

The 256GB model is currently discounted to $599.99 at Amazon and Costco, while the 512GB model with Touch ID is available for $699.99 via the same retailers (Amazon / Costco). MacBook Neo

 $799 $699.99 at Amazon (512GB, Touch ID)

Apple’s budget-friendly MacBook leverages the A18 Pro processor, a chip originally found in the iPhone 16 Pro, to keep costs down. Di Benedetto was impressed by the vivid 13-inch screen and speakers, the latter of which are better than those in many cheap (and even midrange) Windows laptops. The Neo isn’t super performant, especially in terms of storage speed and total memory, but it’s great for everyday tasks, casual use, and students.

articles.title: Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly
articles.description:
Independent Android app developers are worried about their privacy after Google announced that from next year many of them will be required to share a phone number and address publicly. The policy change is intended to meet European Union regulations under the Digital Services Act, but Google says contact details will be made public worldwide.
Developers have until February 1st 2027 to declare whether or not they're a "trader" under UK and European law. Broadly speaking, Google says the definition applies if you earn revenue from your apps, especially if that revenue is regular or at high volume. Developers are exempt if their apps are only …

articles.description: Le nouveau patron des activités internationales de Barrick Mining est en visite au Mali. articles.description: Destruction de Gaza, guerres en Iran, colonisation accélérée en Cisjordanie depuis vingt ans… Le premier ministre israélien est le premier responsable du désamour des Américains envers l’Etat hébreu, alors même qu’il a construit son image sur sa proximité avec les Etats-Unis, pays où il a été élevé et formé, note Alain Frachon, chroniqueur au « Monde ».

articles.title: Disney Plus, Hulu, and HBO Max are all over 50 percent off for Black Friday
articles.description:
HBO’s A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms takes a surprisingly charming approach to Westerosi medievalism. | Image: HBO	

Black Friday isn’t just a good time to save on a new TV but also a chance to spend less on what you watch on it. The shopping holiday often brings steep streaming discounts, and this year is no exception, with some streamers offering more than 50 percent off. HBO Max, Apple TV, and Hulu are all offering deals, with several plans going for just a few dollars a month. Some discounts even apply to ad-free plans, though there are fewer than last year and prices are generally higher.
Still, you can save big if you don’t mind a few commercials. Right now, for example, you can get a year of the ad-supported Disney Plus and Hulu bundle for $4.99 a month, saving you $96, or sign up for the most basic HBO Max plan for $5.49 a month for 12 months, saving you $66. We’ve rounded up these deals and more below, including what each plan offers and how long you can take advantage of the discounted rate.
Disney Plus and Hulu
Disney Plus, Hulu Bundle

Where to Buy:

 $12.99 $4.99 at Hulu (ad-supported, monthly)
 $21.99 $14.99 at Hulu (ad-free, monthly)

With everything from Disney classics and Marvel movies to FX dramas like The Bear and Shōgun, the Disney Plus and Hulu bundle offers plenty for the whole family to watch. For Black Friday, you can get both services with ads for just $4.99 per month ($8 off) for a year via Hulu or Disney Plus, saving you $96 in total. The ad-free bundle is also on sale for $14.99 per month ($7 off) for 12 months, saving you $84. Both discounts are available through 11:59PM PT on November 30th.
Whichever plan you choose, you’ll get access to both streaming libraries. Hulu offers dramas like Furious, Alien: Earth, The Lowdown, and The Handmaid’s Tale, as well as comedies like Bob’s Burgers, Futurama, and It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia. Disney Plus, meanwhile, is home to Disney and Pixar favorites, The Simpsons, and a wide selection of Star Wars and Marvel movies and shows. It’s also a good option for holiday movie nights, with classics like Home Alone and The Santa Clause.
HBO Max
HBO Max

Where to Buy:

 $10.49 $5.49 at Amazon (monthly, with ads)
 $10.99 $5.49 at HBO Max (monthly, with ads)

HBO Max is home to some of Hollywood’s biggest releases, and right now, you can watch them for half the usual rate. Now through November 30th, new and returning subscribers can sign up for HBO Max’s Basic With Ads plan for $5.49 a month via HBO Max or Amazon, saving you $66 over the course of a year.
Although the plan doesn’t include live sports, it supports simultaneous streaming on two devices and gives you access to everything from award-winning films like Sinners and Marty Supreme to Wuthering Heights. There’s arguably even more to watch on the TV front, from dramas like The Gilded Age, Lanterns, Euphoria, and Heated Rivalry to comedies such as Hacks and The Righteous Gemstones. Fantasy fans, meanwhile, can immerse themselves in the world of Game of Thrones and its spinoffs, including House of the Dragon and A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, or check out Dune: Prophecy. You’ll also be able to stream new releases, including HBO’s upcoming Harry Potter series.
Peacock
Peacock

Where to Buy:

 $8.99 $2.99 at Peacock (monthly, Select)
 $12.99 $8.99 at Peacock (monthly, Premium)
 $89.99 $29.99 at Peacock (annual, Select)

If you’re looking for an affordable way to catch up on NBC shows, Peacock’s Black Friday promotion offers two ways to save. Through November 30th, new and returning subscribers can sign up for Peacock Select for $2.99 a month ($6 off) for three months or $29.99 ($60 off) for a full year. For access to Peacock’s larger catalog, you can also subscribe to Peacock Premium for $8.99 per month for three months or $89.99 ($40 off) for a year.
The cheaper Select tier is a particularly good value if you mainly watch shows from networks like NBC, Bravo, and Telemundo, including Saturday Night Live, The Office, and Below Deck. Movie buffs and sports fans, however, will prefer Premium, which offers access to a much wider selection of entertainment. Peacock’s catalog includes films like The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, Disclosure Day, and Minions & Monsters, along with shows like The Good Daughter, Dig, and The Paper. A Premium subscription also lets you watch live sporting events, including Sunday Night Football, as well as Peacock originals, such as the various Love Island spinoffs.
Paramount Plus
Paramount Plus (monthly subscription)

Where to Buy:

 $8.99 $2.99 at Paramount (Essential)
 $13.99 $2.99 at Paramount (Premium)

If you’re a Star Trek fan or want another way to watch live sports, Paramount Plus is down to $2.99 per month for two months for Black Friday. New and eligible returning subscribers can take advantage of the discount through November 30th, bringing the cost of both the Essential and Premium plans to $5.98 for the introductory period. That makes Premium a particularly good deal, since it normally costs $13.99 a month, compared to $8.99 for the ad-supported Essential tier.
Paramount Plus includes CBS shows like NCIS and Everybody Loves Raymond to Tulsa King and the various Yellowstone spinoffs, including both 1883 and 1923. Movie fans can also browse Paramount’s film library, which includes titles like Arrival, Top Gun, and Interstellar, while sports fans can watch select NFL games, UFC events, UEFA Champions League matches, and March Madness games. Premium also grants you access to Showtime originals and a live feed of your local CBS station, along with ad-free on-demand viewing, though live programming still includes commercials.
Apple TV 
Apple TV (six-month subscription)

Where to Buy:

 $15 $7 at Amazon (monthly)

Apple TV has built an impressive collection of acclaimed shows, particularly if you’re into sci-fi shows like Silo or thrillers like Slow Horses. Right now, US customers with an Amazon account can subscribe to Apple TV through Amazon for $6.99 per month ($8 off) for six months, saving $48 over the introductory period. Amazon hasn’t listed an end date for the promotion, either.
Six months should give you plenty of time to work through Apple’s other originals, including Severance, Pachinko, The Morning Show, and Pluribus, or settle in for a movie like Arrival or Anchorman. The service also includes live sports, specifically Formula 1 races and Major League Soccer matches.
Crunchyroll
Crunchyroll

 $9.99 $3.99 at Crunchyroll (Fan)
 $13.99 $5.99 at Crunchyroll (Mega fan)
 $17.99 $8.99 at Crunchyroll (Ultimate fan)

Anime fans can spend the next six months catching up on shows like The Apothecary Diaries, Jujutsu Kaisen, Black Clover, and One Piece for a lot less thanks to Crunchyroll’s Black Friday sale. All three subscriptions offer access to Crunchyroll’s full anime library without ads, including new episodes shortly after they air in Japan. The Fan tier lets you watch on one device at a time, while Mega Fan increases that limit to four devices and adds offline viewing and access to Crunchyroll’s Game Vault. Ultimate Fan, meanwhile, supports six simultaneous streams and includes Crunchyroll Manga, along with additional store perks.
Starz

 $69.99 $11.99 at Starz (annual)
 $10.99 $2.99 at Starz (monthly)

If you didn’t get a chance to watch the Michael Jackson biopic Michael when it was released earlier this year or just want to catch up on Outlander, Starz is offering a particularly affordable way to stream both on Black Friday. Eligible subscribers can sign up for a year directly through Starz or Amazon Prime for $11.99 ($58 off), which works out to about $1 a month when you pay upfront. If you’d rather not commit to a year, you can alternatively subscribe for $2.99 per month ($9 off) for three months. Either option lets you explore Starz’s catalog of films and TV shows, including In the Grey, Power Ballad, Splash City, and P-Valley.
Other streaming deals of note
Amazon is also discounting a wide range of subscriptions through Prime Video, including NBA League Pass, AMC Plus, MGM Plus, and several bundles. Most of the deals below are available through November 30th.
Now through December 1st, you can get the standard version of NBA League Pass for $49.99 ($60 off); the Premium tier is also available for $74.99 ($85 off).

You can also get AMC Plus, MGM Plus, and Starz together for $5.49 per month (about $16 off) for two months.

If you’re planning a holiday movie marathon this weekend, Hallmark Plus is available for $2.25 per month (about $7 off) for three months.

BritBox, which offers British series like The Other Bennet Sister, is available for $2.75 per month (around $8 off) for two months.

articles.title: Here’s where you can save (a little) on the Ocarina of Time remake
articles.description:
The Nintendo Switch 2 remake delivers a complete graphical overhaul and numerous quality-of-life updates to the ‘98 classic. | Image: Nintendo	

A lot of people have The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Nintendo Switch 2 on their holiday wishlist. In case you haven’t bought it yet, I wanted to share some small but welcome deals happening on the physical and digital versions of the game. Costco members can currently grab the cartridge edition for $62.99, down from its regular price of $69.99 (it’s the only retailer currently discounting the physical version). Both Amazon and Costco are also selling the digital version for $54.99, a small $5 discount.
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

Where to Buy:

 $59.99 $54.99 at Amazon (Digital)
 $69.99 $62.99 at Costco (Physical)

Ocarina of Time is one of Nintendo’s most groundbreaking titles, having served as its first 3D Zelda game when it launched in 1998. Parts of the original game haven’t aged particularly well — namely some dungeon design and the game’s tricky 3D navigation, since there was only one analog stick at the time — which makes it tough for some to enjoy going back to play the N64 version. Thankfully, the Switch 2 remake introduces several fixes, a host of quality-of-life improvements, and, of course, some lovely visuals that make it a graphics powerhouse by today’s standards.
If you go the digital route, a recent Switch 2 update lets you gift games to players in your family group. It doesn’t have to be your actual family, either, just up to eight people you designate as part of your group. The digital game will then appear gift-wrapped on their homescreen.
